description.text:
Piaget, a language model finetuned on 15k psychological and philosophical reasoning traces.

Piaget is based on Qwen3 and was finetuned on a subset of open reasoning traces from Dolphin R1 and General Reasoning.

output_type.quote: "role": "user", "content": "Create a new psychotherapeutic technique based on cybernetic principles"

use_claim.quote: Piaget aims to reason about psychological and philosophical concepts such as self-image, emotion, and existence.

serving.notes: The card example also sets max_new_tokens=2048 and do_sample=True. Training max length on the card is 2048. tokenizer_config.json has no chat_template key and model_max_length 131072. The chat template inserts a system message only if the caller supplies one. The repository ships four safetensors shards and model.safetensors.index.json, and has no adapter_config.json. Hub safetensors metadata reports 8190735360 parameters. The model page labels the size as 8B params. The model tree lists Qwen/Qwen3-8B-Base above Qwen/Qwen3-8B. A host page, https://featherless.ai/models/gustavecortal/Piaget-8B, says the context length is 32,768 tokens.

evaluation_reported.text: Piaget-8B achieves the best faithfulness gap (∆ = − 0.007)

discrepancies: The Hub API now lists Dolphin R1 as QuixiAI/dolphin-r1 and GeneralThought-430K as RJT1990/GeneralThoughtArchive. The card and the inventory still use the older ids, and the renamed dataset pages still load.
